messages:
Marta: Heads-up — Tue 10am PT panel for Candidate A. Quick preboard checklist: scribe, AV, rubric weights, captioning. @Samir can you cover scribe? Candidate requested live captioning and a 10min buffer.
Samir: I can scribe but I'm on-call that morning. I can take first ~45m, need a backup for the tail.
Josh: I'll be backup scribe. Quick question: do we want to shift rubric weights? I thought we had 50/30/20 (sys-design/product/culture) last round.
Lee: We discussed moving to 40/30/30 in the hiring rubric doc to emphasize product+culture. See https://docs.redwood.ai/hiring/rubric — looks like the change was proposed last month.
Marta: Perfect — let's go 40/30/30 for this round. @Devex Bot can you post the Zoom link + access token ~2h before? Also confirm captioning is enabled. Candidate asked for recording consent; they said yes.
Devex Bot: Will do. Posting reminder 2h before. Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890. Captioning: auto-caption enabled. Recording consent: confirmed by candidate in intake form.
Samir: If recording is OK I can capture transcript. Plan to use ASR + scribe pipeline. Recorder command for infra ops if helpful:
```
/start-scribe --room 1234567890 --dest s3://interviews/2026-03-30/candidateA/ --asr auto
```
Lee: Rubric clarification: for system-design score, prioritize architecture trade-offs and scaling rationale over line-by-line code. Please add a one-line note for "architectural tradeoffs" when scoring.
Josh: Got it. Debrief window — is it 24h or 48h to submit feedback? And where do we drop notes (doc/form)?
Marta: Debrief window: 48h for full feedback. Use the /interview-debrief form (link in handbook) or drop a short note in the calendar invite if urgent. I’ll ping post-interview at EOD to nudge any stragglers.
Samir: Adding backup scribe to the calendar invite now and tagging @Josh for the second half. I’ll also enable transcript export to the shared bucket.
Josh: I can take the back half if needed. :thumbsup:
Marta: Great — thanks everyone. Final check 2h before, I’ll confirm captioning + recorder status then.
